sn34.6:1.5: One meditator is skilled in the territory of immersion but not in immersion.
sn34.6:1.6: One meditator is skilled neither in immersion nor in the territory of immersion.
sn34.6:1.7: One meditator is skilled both in immersion and in the territory of immersion.
sn34.6:1.8: Of these, the meditator skilled both in immersion and in the territory of immersion is the foremost, best, leading, highest, and finest of the four.
